rust_summary: a pickup with the whole stack, the item's thrower and position (`native_item_picked_up_v2`), leaving `native_item_picked_up` as it was.
doc_summary: `native_item_picked_up_v2(player, stack, thrower, position, canceled)`: an additive version of `native_item_picked_up` with the whole stack (its components), the item entity's thrower UUID (none for block or mob drops) and its position. Heard just before v1, which hears nothing of a pickup canceled here. v1 keeps its signature and firing point. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:item_picked_up_v2@`.
